# healthchecksio_flips (Data Source)

The status changes (flips) of one check. The server keeps the flips of this month and of the two months before it. A read-only API key is sufficient.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The status changes of the last 7 days.
data "healthchecksio_flips" "backup" {
  check_id = healthchecksio_check.backup.id
  seconds  = 604800
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `check_id` (String) The check: its unique_key (the `id` of `healthchecksio_check`) or its UUID.

### Optional

- `end` (Number) Give only the flips before this UNIX time.
- `seconds` (Number) Give only the flips of the last number of seconds.
- `start` (Number) Give only the flips at or after this UNIX time.

### Read-Only

- `flips` (Attributes List) The flips, the newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--flips))

<a id="nestedatt--flips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `flips`

Read-Only:

- `timestamp` (String) The time of the flip (RFC 3339).
- `up` (Boolean) True for a change to up, false for a change to down.
